prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adoption page: Interactive new flows like pet preview (+8.0%) and personality trait quiz (+12.0%) are helpful, though another new flow and redesign showed no clear effect; quiz predictions were too low (+7.5% vs +12.0%).
Finish page: Redesigning for desktop placement celebration was highly helpful (+26.0% win, predictions far too low at -5.0%), whereas another redesign, hints, and new flows showed no clear effect.
Sign-in page: Redesigning for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win, accurately predicted), while hint and layout modifications showed no clear effect.
Choose_path page: Reordering steps hurt performance (-4.8% loss, predictions far too high at +5.0%), while layout, hint, and copy changes showed no clear effect.
Home page: Background audio completion notifications hurt performance (-6.3% loss), while waiting info, new flows, and desktop notification prompts showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Voice Selection Flow: Introduces an interactive voice tone selector on the pick_friend screen, letting users preview audio greetings and pick their pet's vocal personality. (why: Interactive adoption flows yielded strong wins (+12% quiz, +8% preview), and users report confusion over interacting with desktop pets.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Shortcuts Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding wrap-up screen showcasing key desktop shortcuts for summoning, hiding, and speaking to the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the desktop pet once setup completes.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Story Carousel Showcase Layout: Switches the initial story intro screen to a visual carousel layout showcasing pet life scenarios. (why: The choose_path step has a high drop-off and long mean completion time (514s); visual story carousels improve early engagement.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Diagnostic Stage Tracker: Displays time estimates and active render diagnostics on the waiting screen during desktop pet preparation. (why: The waiting step has high mean latency (2336s), and 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop after setup.)
4: [home, new_flow] Interactive Whistle Sound Test Flow: Adds an interactive audio call test sound button on the waiting screen so users can test desktop speaker output while waiting. (why: Interactive waiting micro-interactions keep users engaged during long rendering times (mean 2336s).)
5: [finish, incentive] Day 1 Desktop Companion Explorer Badge: Adds a Day 1 Explorer milestone badge component on the home_intro finish screen. (why: Desktop celebration changes proved extremely successful (+26.0% win on finish screen redesign); milestone badges build instant momentum.)
